verdict.rationale: Flagsmith's experimentation docs state that A/B results are read through a built-in Bayesian statistics engine, fed by events collected into a managed data warehouse. However, the evidence is only a one-line claim with no methodology detail and nothing on variance reduction. Missing for 10: variance-reduction options (e.g. CUPED), documentation of the statistical methodology (priors, decision thresholds, metric handling), independent or hands-on corroboration of result trustworthiness.
